label: approach
definition: The empty gripper moves toward an object.
starts_when: the empty gripper starts moving toward an object
success_when: the object is one the task instruction asks the robot to pick

label: grasp
definition: The fingers close on an object until it moves with the gripper.
ends_when: the object first moves with the gripper
success_when: the object is lifted between the fingertips

label: transport
definition: The gripper carries the object toward its target.
ends_when: the gripper stops above the place where it will open
success_when: that place is the target the task instruction names

label: place
definition: The object is lowered or held above the target and released.
starts_when: the object is lowered or held above the target
success_when: the released object rests on or in the target the task instruction names

label: retreat
definition: The opened gripper moves away from the target.
ends_when: the gripper has moved clear of the target
success_when: what was placed is not disturbed

label: other
definition: A human hand acts, the robot is idle, or nothing recognisable happens.
starts_when: a human hand acts, the robot is idle, or nothing recognisable happens
ends_when: the robot resumes a recognisable subtask
